name: Casting Stones
overview: Scripture addresses the serious consequences of sin, such as adultery, which under the Old Testament law demanded severe judgment to maintain holiness among God's people (Leviticus 20:10; Deuteronomy 17:7). Yet, Christ’s teaching in the New Testament calls believers to self-examination before judging others, warning against hypocrisy by highlighting the need to first address one’s own faults (Matthew 7:3). Furthermore, Jesus instructs believers to discern with righteous judgment rather than superficial appearances (John 7:24), while remaining vigilant against false teachers who disguise themselves deceptively (Matthew 7:15). Ultimately, God’s love is demonstrated through Christ’s sacrifice, offering forgiveness and eternal life to those who believe (John 3:16), underscoring that judgment belongs to God alone and must be exercised with humility and truth.
